newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt/currency market closing report.

text.p: Swedish debt yields fell and the crown firmed against the mark, mainly on a cut in the Riksbank's repo rate cut by 25 basis points to 4.35 percent, although stronger foreign markets also lent support, dealers said.

"Many people expected the Riksbank to cut its key rate this morning after central bank governor Urban Backstrom's comments on Monday. When the cut turned out to be as large as it was, yields continued down," one dealer said.
Six-month T-bill rates fell 13 basis point to 4.26 percent. The 10-year bond yields dropped 12 basis points to 7.08 pct.
